title: Short-play filtering and History fixes
summary: Hide brief playback checks from History and statistics, with fixes for replays, restores and request metadata.
highlights: Set a minimum viewing time under Settings > Exclusions > Short plays. Try 60 or 120 seconds; 0 keeps the current behavior. Hidden plays stay saved and reappear when you lower the value.
The filter uses sampled viewing time and also applies to library activity and CSV exports. Older plays without measured time remain visible. Live sessions and playback alerts are unchanged.
Replaying a finished item keeps the earlier viewing as a separate play. Playback samples captured during a History restore are queued and retried afterward.

Jellyseerr retries missing titles and posters. Other fixes keep collection running after invalid stream metadata, preserve local logout when revocation fails, and reject invalid SSL verification flags.
